description: Source code for an Odoo module wizard that manages installation of specific modules related to profile association, including configuration options and actions to install modules.

classes.name: profile_association_config_install_modules_wizard
classes.description: Wizard class for configuring and installing modules related to profile association in Odoo.

methods.name: action_cancel
methods.description: Cancels the wizard and returns to the configuration form.

methods.name: action_install
methods.description: Reads selected options, searches and installs corresponding modules, then restarts the pool.
